claim: In the matching retail DLL, instance Menu_SoundManager.MyMusic_Play (0x060052B8) has exact signature blob 20020211aa2411aa18, parameters (SYSTEM_SOUND bgm, PLAY_TYPE type), and an exact 481-byte body. It initializes a Boolean local false and switches raw bgm-32 with raw 32 and raw 35 sharing the Progress branch, raw 33 using Admission and raw 34 using Match; the switch default jumps directly to the shared tail. Each named branch calls this.MyMusic_CheckFile on its corresponding static selected filename; a false result writes System.String.Empty back to that selected filename and returns false. Successful Progress writes MyMusic_SelectFile_Name = Root_DirectotyPath + MyMusic_SelectFile_Progress and MyMusic_Volume = Volume_BgmProgress. Successful Admission and Match similarly write the combined selected path and their corresponding volume, then inspect Path.GetExtension(MyMusic_SelectFile_Name).ToLower() for exact string '.mp3'. At the shared tail, when that Boolean is false it calls this.StartCoroutine('MyMusic_Play_Co') and pops the returned Coroutine. The method then returns true.
